Budget.description: What an attempt may spend (S-0001/domain); None on an axis is no bound there.

iterations.description: The most attempts the loop makes before it escalates; a drafting run's drafts.
iterations.title: Iterations

tokens.description: The tokens the broker lets an attempt spend, enforced mid-run (S-0045/D-4).
tokens.title: Tokens

wallclock_minutes.description: The wall-clock bound of an attempt, in minutes — declared, read by no leg yet.
wallclock_minutes.title: Wallclock Minutes

Budget.title: Budget

InheritedDecision.description:
One row as a contract carries it (charter §3; S-0054 S-0054/D-1): grade,
text and paths copied at mint and fingerprinted; `consequence` beside
them so the executor gets the reason, and `check` — a command whose
exit code judges the row — which the runner appends to the battery as
a `decision:<id>` gate at `check_state`, with `check_twin` the test
that proves the check can fail (S-0054/D-4). A contract minted before
S-0054 loads with the four defaults, which is the old behaviour.

check.description: A command whose exit code judges the row, run as the `decision:<id>` gate (S-0054/D-4).
check.title: Check

check_state.description: The check's gate state: `shadow` until an amendment promotes it (S-0054/D-4).
check_state.title: Check State

check_twin.description: The test that proves the check can fail (S-0054/D-4).
check_twin.title: Check Twin

consequence.description: Why the row exists — the reason beside the rule, so the executor gets both (S-0054/D-1).
consequence.title: Consequence

grade.description: The row's grade as it stood at mint — copied, so the executor reads what the author settled.
grade.title: Grade

paths.description: The area the row governs, declared; what enables the silence check.
paths.title: Paths

text.description: The decision's text as it stood at mint.
text.title: Text

InheritedDecision.title: InheritedDecision

Scope.description:
allow/deny globs, gitwildmatch semantics. deny wins over allow; an empty
allow means unconstrained (S-0002/scope-in-detail).

allow.description: Globs of what the task may touch, gitwildmatch; empty means unconstrained.
allow.title: Allow

deny.description: Globs the task may not touch; deny wins over allow.
deny.title: Deny

Scope.title: Scope

description:
The task contract, `.torve/tasks/T-NNNN/contract.yaml` (S-0001/domain, §6).

`decisions` has no default on purpose: an empty list is legal but must be
explicit (S-0007/D-5), so `decisions-reported` can distinguish "none apply"
from "the field was forgotten".

character.description:
The phase's declared structural or routine character, copied verbatim from
the phasing entry at mint (S-0034/D-1). Absent by default — a task with no
character routes on the seat alone, same as one with no tier_variant.
character.title: Character

decisions.description:
The rows inherited at mint, grade and paths copied (S-0007/D-5); an empty
list is legal but must be explicit.
decisions.title: Decisions

depends_on.description: The tasks that must land before this one dispatches.
depends_on.title: Depends On

intent.description:
One paragraph: what changes and why — never steps (S-0001/D-7, S-0001/A-4).
Optional until the S-0001/A-4 execution makes minting enforce it; contracts
minted before the amendment carry none.
intent.title: Intent

parent.description:
Set only at adoption of a decomposition's children (S-0026/D-5): projections
group by it; dispatch, lane and store never read it — ordering stays
depends_on alone.
parent.title: Parent

phase.description: The phasing entry the contract was minted from; 0 when no phase minted it.
phase.title: Phase

role.description: What the run does: implement, review (S-0005/D-9), revert (S-0010) or draft (S-0020).
role.title: Role

schema_version.description: The contract's shape version: 2 names the document as `spec` (S-0059/D-1).
schema_version.title: Schema Version

scope.description: What the attempt may and may not touch (S-0002/scope-in-detail).

source.description:
What asked for the work (S-0060/D-3): a source identifier, `S-NNNN` or
`<kind>/<slug>`, never parsed for inheritance. `spec` says whose rows this
contract inherits and this says why it exists; a contract may carry both,
either or neither, and the record reads this before `spec` before
`operator`.
source.title: Source

spec.description:
The document the contract was minted from, by identifier and never by path
(S-0059/D-1) — `document_dir` is the one lookup that finds it. None is the
document-less lane: an operator's ask, a standing job.
spec.title: Spec

targets.description:
The tasks a review examines (S-0005/the-review-contract, S-0005/D-9) or the
tasks and shas a revert undoes (S-0010/revert-as-a-role): the contract shape
is parameterised by role, no new mechanism. Only those two roles carry targets.
targets.title: Targets

tier.description: The seat that runs it — planner, executor or reviewer (S-0004).
tier.title: Tier

tier_variant.description:
An optional dotted variant under the seat (S-0027/D-3), resolved as
`tier.variant` in the tiers mapping — a variant refines a seat, never invents
one, and role semantics still key on `tier` alone. Naming a variant that is
not configured is a refused dispatch, not a fallback.
tier_variant.title: Tier Variant

title.description:
A short human name (S-0007/A-1): the landing subject and every board row read
it; empty falls back to the intent's first line. The planner mints it from the
phase title; a drafter may set it.
title.title: Title

title: Task
